regions.cleaned_text: You may think sometimes that it is hard to keep up courage. One phase of contentment - rather I will say a feature of the key to contented peace, - is this: To try to realiz the contrast ( rather than the difference) between Time and Eternity. At the longest time must be so short. But O! Who can fathom Eternity ?!! Then be grateful for what we have -- Existence -- The True Faith God made me to know Him - O what a bles'd aim! To love Him and serve Him sure reste in the same. It's Heaven begun - for the grateful on earth To treasure aright? !? !! ... Highest Heaven its worth. Be sure, if the enemy of our souls is pleased at any thing in us it is ingratitude - of whatever kind. Why? ingrati- tude leads to so many brakes with God & neighbor. "Whom the Lord loveth He chasteneth. Some day you will thank God for having been leaf. . God bless you Dorothy B. ...
